Declaration

This tool is calculated based on the appearance probability of Fortnite tokens as published on the internet. It is not the game's probability — the figures shown here are not Fortnite's actual in-game odds and are not an official in-game rate.

What the tool does

One job, done cleanly: it turns a fluctuating time multiplier into a probability you can actually read.

1

Live time multiplier, every second

The multiplier re-rolls once per second from your local clock. Turn fluctuation off and it holds still; turn it on and you watch the odds breathe in real time.

2

Weighted low — highs stay rare

The roll is weighted toward the low end: 70% of rolls land between ×0.10 and ×0.70, and only about 7% of the time reaches ×2.00 or above. The average sits around ×0.73, not the ×1.65 of a flat random roll.

3

Effective probability, spelled out

Every multiplier is converted against the tool's built-in 1 / 137,500 base rate and shown both ways — as odds (1 / 183,333) and as a percentage — with a colour-coded status: low, normal, or high probability.

4

Gold coin moment

When the multiplier reaches ×2.00 or higher, a gold coin emblem appears in the corner of the window, so a genuinely high window is impossible to miss.

5

Clean, readable interface

A solid dark UI: oversized gold multiplier, clear section labels, and generous spacing. Text redraws cleanly every second — no overlapping or garbled digits.

6

Offline activation, no account

The tool activates once with an offline license key generated for your machine code. No server, no sign-up, no subscription — activation is permanent for that PC and the tool never needs the internet.

How the probability works

The math is simple and fully transparent — nothing is hidden, and nothing about the game itself is changed.

The tool is built on a base rate of 1 in 137,500 per chest for the Pirate Shop (Treasure Hunters) event. It multiplies that base rate by the current time multiplier:

effective odds = 137,500 ÷ multiplier
e.g. ×0.75 → 1 / 183,333 (0.000545%)

The multiplier itself is drawn from a weighted-low distribution, so most seconds are quiet and high multipliers are genuinely uncommon:

70% low band 20% mid band 10% high band
BandMultiplierShare of rolls
Low×0.10 – ×0.7070%
Mid×0.70 – ×1.5020%
High×1.50 – ×3.0010%
×2.00 or above (gold coin)×2.00 – ×3.00≈ 7%
Long-run average≈ ×0.73—

What is a Treasure Hour?

Treasure Hours are limited windows during the Treasure Hunters event when your Pirate Shop Access odds are boosted. Outside those windows, the chest odds above stay flat — which is why timing is the whole point of watching the multiplier in the tool.

Every Treasure Hour so far and announced is listed on Fortnite.bot in your local timezone, with a countdown to the next one.

From Epic Games: “Treasure drop rates from chests are constant since season launch and don’t vary throughout the day, except during Treasure Hours. Other than Gizmos, you can’t get the same treasure twice.”
In other words: the table on the left is the published, steady rate for a normal match. This tool does not change it — it only shows what the effective figure looks like when a multiplier is applied locally.

Download

Windows may show a SmartScreen prompt for a small unsigned utility like this one — choose “More info” → “Run anyway”. You can verify the file with the SHA-256 hash above. An activation key is required on first launch; see the activation steps below.

Activation in four steps

Activation is fully offline. Each PC gets its own machine code, and each machine code gets its own key.

1

Run the tool

On first launch, an activation window opens instead of the main interface. Nothing else is needed — no account, no internet.

2

Copy your machine code

The window shows a unique code for your PC in XXXX-XXXX-XXXX format, built from your drive and network hardware. Click “Copy Machine Code”.

3

Get your license key

Send the machine code to the seller / distributor. They generate a matching XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX key for that machine code and send it back.

4

Activate — once

Paste the key and click Activate. A license.dat file is saved next to the .exe and every later launch opens straight into the tool.

The key is tied to the machine code: replacing your hard drive or network adapter changes the code and requires a new key.

Questions

Does this tool change my actual odds in Fortnite?

No. The event rate is decided on the game's servers and cannot be changed by any local program. This tool only performs the multiplier calculation locally, so you can see what the effective probability looks like at any given second. As the note in the app itself says: the multiplier only affects the calculation in this tool.

Where does the 1 / 137,500 figure come from?

It is the base rate built into the tool — one in 137,500 chests, before any multiplier is applied — and the figure the entire calculation is calibrated to. The tool divides that base figure by the current multiplier to show the effective odds. As stated in the declaration above, this calculation is based on the appearance probability of Fortnite tokens as published on the internet — it is not the game's probability.

Do I need an internet connection?

No. The tool runs entirely offline, including activation. The license key is checked locally against your machine code.

Why does the multiplier feel low most of the time?

By design. 70% of rolls fall in the ×0.10–×0.70 band and only about 7% of seconds reach ×2.00 or higher, for a long-run average of roughly ×0.73. High-probability moments are meant to be the exception, not the norm.

What else can a chest drop besides Pirate Shop Access?

Plenty — Pirate Shop Access is just the rarest useful one for this tool. Per chest in a normal match: Gold Outfit 1 in 1,562,500, Vehicle & Decal 1 in 7,813, Pickaxe or Back Bling 1 in 568, Jam Track 1 in 391, Loading Screen 1 in 272, and Gizmo (Any) 1 in 127. See the full table in Treasure Hours, odds & prizes above. Other than Gizmos, you can’t get the same treasure twice.

What is a Treasure Hour, and when is the next one?

A Treasure Hour is a limited window when Pirate Shop Access odds are boosted. Outside Treasure Hours, chest drop rates are constant and don’t vary through the day. For the next Treasure Hour countdown in your timezone and the full weekly prize list, see Fortnite.bot — Treasure Prizes.

Does it work on Mac or mobile?

No. The downloadable tool is a Windows .exe and runs on Windows PCs only. This page is for downloading the file and reading the setup information.
